etymologies.heading: Etymology
paragraphs: From French péripatétique, from Latin peripatēticus, from Ancient Greek περιπατητικός (peripatētikós, “given to walking around”), from περιπατέω (peripatéō, “to walk around”), from περί (perí, “around”) (English peri-)+ πατέω (patéō, “to walk”).
senses: One who walks about; a pedestrian; an itinerant.
(philosophy, usually capitalized) Alternative letter-case form of Peripatetic (“Aristotelian”).
